C2_RESOLUTION.resolution_direction: null >= observed → metric FAILS null test (C2=true)
C2_RESOLUTION.resolution_rationale: The original FALSIFIED verdict was triggered because observed (0.3) did not exceed null (0.5275). The intent of the null-model test is: 'does the observed ordering exceed chance?' If null >= observed, the answer is NO — the observed ordering does not exceed chance. This aligns falsifier and decision_rule: both say null >= observed is bad for the metric.

coherent_C2_semantics.C2_true: null_mean >= observed → observed does NOT exceed chance → metric FAILS null test
coherent_C2_semantics.C2_false: null_mean < observed → observed EXCEEDS chance → metric SURVIVES null test

C2_RESOLUTION.consistency_check: With this resolution, the falsifier ('null > observed → FALSIFIED'), decision_rule ('null >= observed → C2=true → SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST'), and null_control ('null >= observed → FALSIFIED verdict stands') all agree: null >= observed is the failure condition. The only remaining asymmetry is strict > vs >= at the boundary null=observed, which is resolved by treating = as failure (consistent with the FALSIFIED intent).

canonical_script_spec_components: 3-definition per-role filtering: DEF-FULL-MAP (a+button+input+combobox), DEF-FORM-ONLY (button+combobox), ISOLATED-A-LINK (a only)
float scaling: use float counts, not integer truncation
density calculation: per definition, per task, count matching roles / total DOM elements
page-type ordering: sort page types by mean density across tasks of that type
null model: random ROLE_MAP assignment, 1000 iterations, seed=42, compute pairwise agreement, compare null mean to observed
C2 evaluation: C2 = true if null_mean >= observed (metric fails), C2 = false if null_mean < observed (metric survives)

observations: B1_SPEC_COHERENCE: The C2 contradiction is confirmed in the frozen spec.json from EXP-INTEL-35137036013. The falsifier clause (F2) states 'null mean > observed' triggers FALSIFIED. The decision_rule clause (C2_NULL_EXCEEDS_OBSERVED) states 'null >= observed' triggers C2=true → SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST. The null_control states 'null >= observed → FALSIFIED verdict stands'. These are logically incompatible at the boundary null=observed.

B2_CANONICAL_SCRIPT_ABSENCE: No script at HEAD implements all four required components (3-definition per-role filtering, cart_1 deduplication, float scaling, null-model with random ROLE_MAP). The closest is reconstruct.py (3-def + dedup + float) but it lacks the null-model implementation. The committed analyze.py uses all-role density (different algorithm). This confirms the blocking dependency: measurement non-reproducible from HEAD without a canonical script.

B3_MEASURE_JS_CAP: The locatableSample cap (if locatableSample.length < 20) is still present at line 89 of measure_fullpage_yield.py. The runtime lane has not removed the substrate blocker. This confirms the substrate dependency remains blocking.

C2_RESOLUTION: The C2 semantic contradiction is resolved by grounding in the original FALSIFIED verdict's statistical intent. The original experiment (EXP-INTEL-35112013458) found null mean 0.5275 > observed 0.3, triggering FALSIFIED. The intent was: 'does the observed ordering exceed chance?' If null >= observed, the answer is NO. The resolution makes both falsifier and decision_rule consistent: null >= observed → metric fails the null test (C2=true). This is a design-resolution exercise grounded in the original experiment's statistical framework, not a new scientific assumption.

CANONICAL_SCRIPT_SPECIFICATION: A concrete 8-component specification is produced (see metrics.canonical_script_spec_components). This specification is consistent with the 3-definition per-role filtering algorithm from reconstruct.py and the resolved C2 direction. It can be implemented by any lane to unblock measurement reproducibility.
validity_notes: This experiment is a dependency audit and design-resolution exercise, not an outcome-bearing measurement. No browser interaction, no data collection, no model calls were required.
All evidence comes from reading committed artifacts (spec.json, code files, MEASURE_JS) — not from re-running measurements.
The C2 resolution is grounded in the original experiment's statistical intent (the FALSIFIED verdict chain from EXP-INTEL-35112013458), not in post-hoc analysis of new data.
The canonical-script specification is a design artifact, not executable code. It must be implemented and tested before it can unblock measurement.

The resolution treats null=observed as failure (consistent with the FALSIFIED intent) but the mathematical boundary case (null exactly equals observed) is unlikely in practice with continuous density values.
